name: alvargo-mcp
description: The official Alvargo Logistics-as-a-Service MCP gateway. Quote freight, access market intelligence, register a shipper, and—with a shipper-scoped MCP key—create, track, and manage Alvargo shipments.

tools.name: quote_freight
tools.description: Get an Alvargo freight quote for a lane.

tools.name: create_shipment
tools.description: Create a live shipment on the Alvargo network.

tools.name: get_shipment
tools.description: Track a shipper-scoped shipment by ID.

tools.name: assign_driver
tools.description: Assign a driver to a shipper-scoped shipment.

tools.name: analyze_freight_image
tools.description: Analyze a freight image for photo-to-quote assistance.

tools.name: register_shipper
tools.description: Register a prospective Alvargo shipper account.
